senses.gloss: m. (פטק = פתק) [ball, stone; cmp. פַּיִּיס,] lot, ballot. —Pl. פִּיטְּקִין.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">Cant. R. to VIII, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00131"><he>דָּדָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:4:7">Y. Snh. I, 19ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>נטל … פ׳ וכ׳</he> Moses took twenty two thousand ballots and wrote on them &c.; <he>בואו וטלו פִּיטְּקֵיכֶן</he> come and draw your ballots.—V. <cite ref="Q02196"><he>פִּתֵּק</he></cite>.
